tiny_test.1pz — bundled minimal .1pz fixture (synthetic, 500 genes x 200 cells).

This file is generated by the pipeline during the first GPU dispatch session
(cycle 25) via:

    singlet process /dev/shm/tiny_fixture/synthetic.1fq \
        --genome-shared --exons $GTF --pipeline \
        --metadata-json /dev/shm/tiny_fixture/meta.json \
        --out-prefix /dev/shm/tiny_fixture/output/

The fixture is then copied here:

    cp /dev/shm/tiny_fixture/output/counts.1pz \
       singlet-gpu/r/inst/extdata/tiny_test.1pz

Size constraint: must be <= 1 MB so R CMD check passes offline.
